name: analyst_questions
description: Caregiver questions for the behavioral analyst evals (src/analyst). One entry = one run. 'num' is the display number; runs/outputs use '<num:02d>_<id>' (e.g. 01_door_unlocked_front). 'group' links variants/sub-questions to a parent question; 'question' is passed verbatim to the planner.
